common.ctaTitle: Tell me what you're trying to do
common.ctaBody: A short conversation is usually enough to work out what the problem actually is and what it takes to solve it. No obligation, and I'll tell you plainly if I am not the right person for it.

services.title: What I can build for your business
services.intro: You don't need to understand the technology, you just need the problem solved. Here's what I do, in plain terms.
services.note: Hosting and the security certificate are part of every plan, and the scope and the price are agreed before anything starts. You'll always know what you are paying for.
services.sectorsIntro: Every sector has its own recurring, solvable problems. Pick yours to see exactly what I would build for you.
services.proofLabel: A head start you already have

website.title: A website that brings you clients
website.description: Not just a page with your logo on it. A site built to turn visitors into phone calls and messages. Fast, mobile-friendly, and available in the languages your customers actually speak.

dataCollection.title: Finding and organizing the information you need
dataCollection.description: Whether it's a list of potential clients, competitor prices, or contact details scattered across dozens of websites, I can gather it automatically and hand it to you as a clean, usable list, updated as often as you need.

automation.title: Putting repetitive tasks on autopilot
automation.description: If your team spends hours every week copying the same information, sending the same messages, or checking the same websites by hand, that work can run by itself instead.

digitization.title: Turning messy paperwork into something usable
digitization.description: PDFs, scanned documents, spreadsheets full of typos, records kept in three different formats. I can turn that mess into something searchable, organized, and easy to work with.

realEstate.name: Property developers
realEstate.headline: More inquiries, less manual work
realEstate.intro: Your projects deserve to be seen by the right buyers, and every inquiry deserves to reach you without getting lost.
realEstate.serviceType: Websites and lead-generation tools for property developers

projectSite.title: A project site that makes people call you
projectSite.description: A showcase of your current developments, with the available units, prices and floor plans, built so every visitor is one tap away from a WhatsApp message. Mobile-first, and in the languages your buyers actually use.

landWatch.title: Finding land opportunities and watching the market
landWatch.description: I can track new listings, land opportunities, and what competing developers are building or pricing, so you're never the last to know.

autoPosting.title: New units posted everywhere at once
autoPosting.description: The moment a unit becomes available, it can go out to Facebook and Instagram automatically, and incoming WhatsApp inquiries can be sorted by project and unit instead of piling up in one chat.

floorPlans.title: Your architect's plans, online instantly
floorPlans.description: PDF floor plans and brochures turned into a browsable, filterable catalog your clients can explore themselves before ever calling you.

realEstate.proof: I've already built a dedicated website template made specifically for property developers. It is trilingual, mobile-first, with every listing one tap away from a WhatsApp conversation.

ecommerce.name: Online retailers
ecommerce.tagline: Sell more, watch the market less
ecommerce.headline: Sell more, watch the market less
ecommerce.intro: Between managing stock, watching competitors, and posting promotions, there's rarely time left to actually sell.
ecommerce.serviceType: Online stores and retail price monitoring

onlineStore.title: An online store that sells even while you sleep
onlineStore.description: A real online storefront: product catalog, easy checkout or WhatsApp ordering, built mobile-first for how your customers actually shop.

priceWatch.title: Watching competitor prices, automatically
priceWatch.description: A live view of what your competitors are charging on the marketplaces where they sell, with instant alerts the moment a price changes. No more manually checking dozens of listings.

promoRestock.title: Promotions and restock alerts that run by themselves
promoRestock.description: Scheduled posts across your social pages, and alerts the moment stock runs low, so nothing slips through while you're focused on the business.

supplierCatalog.title: Turning your supplier lists into a clean product catalog
supplierCatalog.description: Messy spreadsheets from suppliers, inconsistent naming, missing images, turned into a clean and organized catalog ready to publish.

ecommerce.proof: I've built price-tracking tools that watch thousands of product listings and send instant alerts the moment a competitor drops their price. It is the same kind of work I've done professionally for retail-intelligence companies.

socialMedia.name: Creators and small brands
socialMedia.tagline: Grow without living on your phone
socialMedia.headline: Grow your audience without living on your phone
socialMedia.intro: Between posting, replying, and finding new people to reach, content work can eat the whole day.
socialMedia.serviceType: Simple sites and content automation for creators and small brands

simpleSite.title: A simple site that turns followers into customers
simpleSite.description: More than a link-in-bio. A small site that showcases what you offer and makes it easy to buy or book, wherever your audience finds you.

audienceDiscovery.title: Finding the people already interested in what you sell
audienceDiscovery.description: I can track relevant conversations and communities where your future customers already hang out, so outreach starts from people who are already interested.

autoPosting.title: Posting and replying without you at the keyboard all day
autoPosting.description: Scheduled posts across platforms, and automatic first replies to common questions, so you're not chained to your phone to keep momentum going.

weeklyReport.title: Turning your engagement stats into a simple weekly report
weeklyReport.description: No more digging through five different apps, just a clear weekly summary of what's working.

socialMedia.proof: I've built tools that automatically post content and engage in relevant online communities. It is the exact kind of manual work that eats up a content creator's day.

healthcare.name: Clinics and healthcare
healthcare.tagline: Less paperwork, more time with patients
healthcare.headline: Less time on paperwork, more time with patients
healthcare.intro: Between paper files, phone calls, and no-shows, the administrative side of a practice can crowd out the actual care.
healthcare.serviceType: Booking websites and digitized patient records for clinics

bookingSite.title: A site your patients can actually use to book
bookingSite.description: Opening hours, services explained in plain language, and a direct way to book or ask a question by WhatsApp, with no confusing forms.

instantRecords.title: Instantly finding any patient's file
instantRecords.description: Once records are digitized, finding a patient's history takes seconds instead of digging through paper files between appointments.

reminders.title: Appointment reminders and confirmations that send themselves
reminders.description: Automatic SMS or WhatsApp reminders before each appointment, to cut down on missed visits without anyone having to make the calls.

digitizeFiles.title: Turning stacks of paper files into a digital, searchable system
digitizeFiles.description: Years of paper records turned into an organized, searchable digital system your staff can actually use.

healthcare.proof: I've already built a system that turns scanned patient records into a searchable digital timetable a doctor can use in seconds. No more digging through paper files between appointments.

manufacturing.name: Manufacturers and institutions
manufacturing.headline: Look established, run smoother
manufacturing.intro: When other businesses and institutions are deciding whether to work with you, your website and internal organization both send a signal.
manufacturing.serviceType: Professional websites and internal tools for manufacturers and institutions

corporateSite.title: A site that shows you're a serious, established operation
corporateSite.description: A professional presence built for the people evaluating you as a supplier or partner, with your capabilities, past work and certifications presented clearly.

supplierTracking.title: Keeping track of suppliers, parts, and regulations
supplierTracking.description: Information scattered across supplier sites, spec sheets, and regulatory pages, gathered and organized so nothing gets missed.

internalWorkflow.title: Internal paperwork and approvals that don't need a person at every step
internalWorkflow.description: Custom internal tools that replace manual coordination between departments, so there is less time spent chasing signatures and status updates.

technicalArchive.title: Turning technical drawings and reports into an organized digital archive
technicalArchive.description: Specs, drawings, and reports scattered across formats and folders, turned into a searchable, organized archive your team can actually find things in.

manufacturing.proof: I've built both the public-facing website and the internal coordination software for a mechanical fabrication and robotics company, from the site that presents them to new clients to the tool their team uses every day internally.

caseStudies.title: Case studies
caseStudies.intro: The work behind the services. These are real projects, described in terms of the problem that was solved rather than the technology used.

priceWatch.title: Automatic price watch and deal alerts
priceWatch.description: Built a tool that watches thousands of product listings across online marketplaces and posts instant alerts the moment a price drops. The kind of manual checking that used to take hours now happens automatically, every few minutes, without anyone watching a screen.

digitalShelf.title: Professional retail-intelligence experience
digitalShelf.description: Worked professionally on "digital shelf" monitoring, tracking how products are priced, positioned and reviewed across online retailers. It is the same kind of work now offered directly to smaller retailers who need it too.

patientsTimetable.title: From paper files to a digital timetable
patientsTimetable.description: Digitized a clinic's scanned patient records into a searchable daily timetable, turning a stack of paper a doctor had to dig through between appointments into something searchable in seconds.

smrisTools.title: A website and an internal coordination tool, built together
smrisTools.description: Built both the public website for a mechanical fabrication and robotics company and a desktop tool their team uses internally to coordinate work. Two different tools solving two different problems for the same client.

contentAutomation.title: Content posting and community engagement, automated
contentAutomation.description: Built tools that post content on a schedule and engage automatically in relevant online communities and discussions, freeing up hours a creator would otherwise spend doing this manually every day.

realEstateTemplate.title: In progress
realEstateTemplate.description: A dedicated trilingual lead-generation website template for property developers, built mobile-first, with every listing one tap away from a WhatsApp inquiry. It is still being finished, and results will be added here once it is live with a client.

contact.title: Let's talk about what you need
contact.intro: Based in Oran, working with businesses across Algeria and beyond. Whichever way you prefer, you'll get a straight answer about what is possible and what it costs.
contact.whatsappHint: Fastest, usually answered the same day
contact.ctaBody: You don't need to arrive with a specification. Describe the problem, and we'll work out together whether it needs a website, a tool, or something else entirely.
